items.passage: Transcript: Hello, riders, this is Thaddeus Kowalczyk at the campus bicycle hub. While the hub's garage is being repaved this month, our mechanics are working out of Room 224 in Calloway Hall. It's a carpeted classroom, so bikes can't come inside. If you've got a flat, take the wheel off at the rack by the side door and carry just the wheel in. We'll swap the tube while you wait. Anything bigger, like brakes or gears, gets booked into our weekly repair clinic. The clinic normally runs Wednesday at twelve-thirty, and we'd planned to shift it to Monday at four-thirty while we're in the classroom. Well, it turns out the room is free on Wednesdays after all, so the clinic stays put. What does move to Monday at four-thirty is the free safety check for new riders. To book either one, call extension 2741.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Campus bicycle hub] What should a student with a flat tyre do?
choices: Take the wheel off by the side-door rack and carry it indoors
Wheel the bike to the hub garage and leave it at the counter
Book the bike into the weekly clinic and drop it off then
Wheel the bike into Room 224 and wait while it is repaired
items.correct_answer: Take the wheel off by the side-door rack and carry it indoors
items.explanation: The speaker says, 'If you've got a flat, take the wheel off at the rack by the side door and carry just the wheel in.' 'Wheel the bike to the hub garage and leave it at the counter' is wrong because 'the hub's garage is being repaved this month'. 'Book the bike into the weekly clinic and drop it off then' is for 'Anything bigger, like brakes or gears', not a flat. 'Wheel the bike into Room 224 and wait while it is repaired' uses the real room and the real 'while you wait', but 'bikes can't come inside'.
